paper_locations.anchor: Theorem 4.1 and equation (4.1); printed tree-height mismatch requires resolution

task_clarification: For z=sum_{i=1}^n x_i, let zHat be the pairwise-summation result under the paper's stochastic-rounding model SR, and K=(sum_i |x_i|)/|z| where z is nonzero.
For every lambda in (0,1), the printed theorem gives |zHat-z|/|z|<=K*sqrt(u*gamma_(2*h)(u))*sqrt(log(2/lambda)) with probability at least 1-lambda, gamma_m(u)=(1+u)^m-1 and h=floor(log_2(n)).
The proof's ceiling split yields tree height ceil(log_2(n)) for some non-powers of two; this packet is not admitted until the printed h-domain conflict is resolved.
scope_constraints: Retain the entire pairwise tree, exact finite coefficient, SR semantics, and all source n rather than silently restricting to powers of two.
Do not substitute an asymptotic O(sqrt(h)*u) result for the displayed inequality.
Do not assume the high-probability error event as a property of the run.
